migration: 1.2.0 renames source-specific names to neutral ones. Pillar cases-and-desk is now cases-and-drafts (lines cases-and-drafts:1 and :2) and metric group desk is now cases. Renamed metrics: kb.moneyAutoSent to kb.purchaseRepliesWithoutReview, live.watchOnlyDays to live.observationDays, live.casesOnDeskShare to live.casesWithDraftShare, privacy.walletEchoBlocked to privacy.identifierEchoBlocked, privacy.dmFirstAllowed to privacy.directContactFirstAllowed, privacy.exportHasWallets to privacy.exportHasIdentifiers; profile minWatchDays is now minObservationDays. The privacy:2 anchors speak of personal identifiers instead of wallets. Scoring is unchanged. Rename the fields in existing packs and regrade; scores from 1.1.0 are not comparable by line id.
levels: 0 to 4, or U (UNMEASURED, 0 points, not a defect). A test that did not run is NOT_RUN and never reads as PASS.
